title: Comparison of the Leuven Protocol With the Glucommander for Postoperative Control of Blood Glucose With IV Insulin
brief_summary: The investigators are testing whether a written protocol or a computerized program can more effectively control blood glucose after surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* s/p open heart or kidney or liver transplant surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* admission blood glucose less than 120 mg/dl
